evidence.quote: Two levels of validation were performed to confirm the results observed in this initial trial; the first validation was achieved by performing quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) on RNA from 7 volunteers from the Montreal cohort for 43 genes selected to represent 8 of the identified transcription nodes and some of their target genes.
